Finds and excavations

  1. 10 November 2026

    Pillar inscription from the reign of Chalukya king Vikramaditya VI read at Kothakota, Telangana

    A heritage research group says a three-sided Kannada inscription on a temple pillar in Wanaparthy district records land gifts made in the early 12th century, under the Kalyana Chalukya ruler Vikramaditya VI.

    Where: Kothakota, Wanaparthy district, Telangana

  2. 8 November 2026

    State dig in Nagapattinam recovers Chola-period bronzes of Nataraja and Sivakami

    Tamil Nadu's archaeology department has found two bronze images, of Nataraja and the goddess Sivakami, about a metre below ground at an excavation in Nagapattinam district. Experts provisionally date them to the 12th century.

    Where: Nagapattinam district, Tamil Nadu

Conferences, lectures and seminars

  1. 11 November 2026

    Spalding Symposium on Indian Religions extends its 2027 call for papers to 20 November

    The 52nd symposium meets in Cambridge from 2 to 4 April 2027 on the theme of making, mapping and maintaining the world. Proposals are now due by 20 November 2026.

    When: 2 April 2027 to 4 April 2027 · Where: Selwyn College and Faculty of Divinity, University of Cambridge, UK · Apply by: 20 November 2026

  2. 5 November 2026

    Indian History Congress moves its 85th session to Puducherry, February 2027

    The annual meeting of Indian historians will not take place in Bengaluru in December. It now runs from 26 to 28 February 2027 at Tagore Government Arts and Science College, and papers are due by 7 February.

    When: 26 February 2027 to 28 February 2027 · Where: Tagore Government Arts and Science College, Puducherry · Apply by: 7 February 2027

Jobs, fellowships, courses and calls

  1. 11 November 2026

    Uppsala University seeks a permanent senior lecturer in Hindi

    The full-time post in the Department of Linguistics and Philology centres on teaching Hindi to undergraduates. Applications close on 11 January 2027.

    Where: Uppsala, Sweden · Apply by: 11 January 2027

  2. 9 November 2026

    Jagiellonian University seeks a postdoctoral researcher for its South Indian song cultures project

    The two-year research post in Kraków belongs to VOICES, a European Research Council project on the pattu song traditions of South India. Applications close on 21 November 2026.

    Where: Kraków, Poland · Apply by: 21 November 2026

  3. 7 November 2026

    American Institute of Indian Studies fellowships for research in India close on 19 November

    AIIS is taking applications for three fellowships that fund research trips to India: one for doctoral students, one for senior scholars and one for early-career scholars. The deadline is 19 November 2026.

    Apply by: 19 November 2026

  4. 6 November 2026

    Sagar university seeks a contract curator for its archaeology department

    Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is offering one curator post at Rs 40,000 a month, on a contract of up to 12 months. Online applications close on 30 November 2026.

    Where: Sagar, Madhya Pradesh · Apply by: 30 November 2026

  5. 6 November 2026

    Rice University advertises its endowed professorship in Jain Studies

    The Tirthankar Shantinath Professorship in Houston is open at assistant level, with associate level and tenure possible for qualified candidates. Materials should arrive by 15 November 2026 for fullest consideration.

    Where: Houston, Texas, USA · Apply by: 15 November 2026

  6. 5 November 2026

    University of Zurich seeks a professor of the cultural history of India

    The open-rank post, described as premodern Indology with the specialisation left open, is at the Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies. It starts on 1 August 2028 and closes to applications on 7 December 2026.

    Where: Zurich, Switzerland · Apply by: 7 December 2026

Sites, policy and conservation

  1. 8 November 2026

    Ministry of Culture signs agreement with Google Arts & Culture to put heritage collections online

    The memorandum covers ASI monuments, national museum holdings, manuscripts documented under Gyan Bharatam and living traditions, with the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at its centre.

    Where: New Delhi
